title: A Space owner can publish the Network Theme Kit: live in the website editor, its faces in the editor page
detail: NetworkKit joins WEBSITE_THEMES_LIVE, so a Space on the Network look publishes its website instead of keeping the house look, and the editor page loads the kit's four faces (NETWORK_KIT_FONT_CLASS) so the preview draws in them as the public site does. The kit was held back until its home, inner pages and thirteen profile kits shipped (#4297, #4329, #4335, #4339). The LIVE-1710 probe line that pinned 'not live until its render is finished' is rewritten on the owner's phrase 'rewrite probe LIVE-1710' (2026-10-29). No live site moves: the earlier network theme keeps its id and render, and The Group is unchanged.

verify.evidence: NetworkKit is in WEBSITE_THEMES_LIVE and the editor page passes the kit's font class.
